title: Call
description: plugin → companion. One platform control-plane operation through the companion, answered by exactly one result with the same callId. Calls are concurrent: several may be in flight and their results may arrive in any order. There is no companion → plugin call. post and done stay explicit frames and never ride this tunnel.

v.description: Protocol version. A shape change is a new version, never an edit of v1 in place.

callId.description: Chosen by the plugin and echoed verbatim on the result. Opaque; a UUID v4 is the recommended form.

op.description: The operation's name. An OPEN vocabulary, never an enum: a closed one here would make every new operation a wire change. But a NAME, never free text: it is the one caller-chosen field either side logs. An op the companion does not serve is an unknown_op result, never a close. The payload's shape is the control plane's to schema and version.

deadlineMs.description: Milliseconds, relative to send. The companion answers by then, with a timed_out result if the operation has not finished. A call never extends the deadline of any request.

payload.description: The operation's input, opaque to the wire. The whole frame is bounded at 262144 encoded bytes (MAX_CALL_PAYLOAD_BYTES); over it the companion answers malformed_payload, never a truncation. Never logged, on either side.
